title: Cloud Storage: buckets, objects and a naming scheme that survives

videos.script: This course follows the data of one company. Quitanda delivers groceries in São Paulo, and every night its shop exports the day's orders. {{export}} Those files have to land somewhere. They have to stay for years, be read by the right people and by nobody else, and cost as little as they can. That is Cloud Storage, and it is the first five lessons. {{gcs}} You will practise it on your own computer. There is no Google Cloud account in this course. The real Google Cloud command line talks to emulators, programs that answer on ports of your laptop. {{emulators}} An emulator answers like the service and checks much less. And for most of Google Cloud there is no emulator at all. This lesson shows you exactly where the imitation ends, so that a success never fools you. {{limits}} Then the first bucket. You will put three files in it and find that the folders you see are not there at all. {{folders}} And you will choose names for buckets and objects that still make sense in five years, because nothing in a bucket can really be renamed. {{names}}
